value.rationale: DEAM's distinctive contribution is its angle-triggered momentum adaptation plus explicit backtracking intended to correct erroneous or zig-zag motion. A full \(180^\circ\) reversal is the natural strongest test of that mechanism. The exact four-versus-five law quantifies both the residual latency and the precise benefit of the backtrack, while showing that the update reverses before the stored momentum does.
